message.content:
An editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a yellow-themed layout. A stylized portrait of a man’s face and shoulders dominates the right side and foreground. He has dark hair, brown eyes, and is wearing a bright yellow collared shirt with a gold pin on the left lapel. To the left, behind the man, is a light yellow landscape depicting a large, curved structure with vertical ribbing, resembling a stadium or industrial facility.

The text at the top reads "BENCANA BIBIT SAPI IMPOR" and "PERWIRA KOPASSUS DI PUSARAN CEBONGAN" in red. The magazine title "TEMPO" appears in large white serif letters, with "EDISI 15-21 APRIL 2013" underneath. In the bottom-left corner, large black block text reads "BANDAR PROYEK PARTAI BERINGIN." Below this, smaller black text states "Bendahara Umum Partai Golkar Setya Novanto diduga mengatur suap penambahan anggaran PON Riau. Selalu lolos dari jerat hukum." The bottom-right corner displays "RP 33.000", website and ISSN information, and a barcode. The entire cover is framed by a thin red border.
